ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Called from an Executable Version Mismatch
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell called from an executable by the version mismatch method Note: Unmapped fields: Data

sequences.query: ((Data = RGX(".*EngineVersion\\=2\\\..*") OR Data = RGX(".*EngineVersion\\=4\\\..*") OR Data = RGX(".*EngineVersion\\=5\\\..*")) AND Data = RGX(".*HostVersion\\=3\\\..*"))
